source: data/eval/dt_decision_2026-11-14/track_d/templates.json (G0, AI-drafted, not native-reviewed); clue = Track D `hint` style; 7 clues shortened by hand to the limits (see shortened)

type_neutral.en: Read your sentence against the prompt, part by part. Where does it say something different?
type_neutral.zh: 把你的句子和原文一部分一部分地对照，哪里说的不一样？
type_neutral.ja: 原文と自分の文を少しずつ比べてみましょう。どこが違うことを言っていますか。

en.label: Missing element
en.clue: Compare “{l}” with the meaning you were asked to express: which idea has gone missing?

zh.label: 成分缺失
zh.clue: 把“{l}”和要表达的意思对照一下：少了哪一层意思？

ja.label: 要素の欠落
ja.clue: 「{l}」を、表したい意味と比べてみましょう。どの内容が抜けていますか。

en.label: Added element
en.clue: Which word(s) in “{l}” have no counterpart in the meaning you were given?

zh.label: 多余成分
zh.clue: “{l}”里哪个词在原文的意思中找不到对应？

ja.label: 余分な要素
ja.clue: 「{l}」の中で、原文の意味に対応しない語はどれですか。

en.label: Word choice
en.clue: Does “{l}” mean exactly what the original says? Which word in it means something different?

zh.label: 用词不当
zh.clue: “{l}”的意思和原文完全一样吗？其中哪个词的意思不对？

ja.label: 語彙選択
ja.clue: 「{l}」は原文と同じ意味になっていますか。意味がずれている語はどれでしょう。

en.label: Collocation
en.clue: Which word normally partners with the other words in “{l}”? Try recalling the phrase as one fixed chunk.

zh.label: 搭配不当
zh.clue: “{l}”里的词通常和哪个词搭配？试着把它当作一个固定短语来回想。

ja.label: コロケーション
ja.clue: 「{l}」の語は、ふつうどの語と一緒に使われますか。決まり文句として思い出してみましょう。

en.label: Word order
en.clue: All the words in “{l}” are fine — can you rearrange them into the order this language requires?

zh.label: 语序错误
zh.clue: “{l}”里的词都对——你能把它们排成正确的顺序吗？

ja.label: 語順
ja.clue: 「{l}」の語はすべて合っています。正しい順番に並べ替えられますか。

en.label: Register
en.clue: Read “{l}” next to the sentences around it: does its level of formality match the passage's style?

zh.label: 语体不符
zh.clue: 把“{l}”和前后句子放在一起读：语气一致吗？用文章的风格该怎么说？

ja.label: 文体・レジスター
ja.clue: 「{l}」を前後の文と並べて読んでみましょう。文体は合っていますか。文章の調子に合わせるとどうなりますか。

en.label: Spelling / script
en.clue: Look closely at how “{l}” is written — can you spot the spelling or character slip?

zh.label: 拼写错误
zh.clue: 仔细看看“{l}”的写法——能发现拼写上的问题吗？

ja.label: 表記
ja.clue: 「{l}」の書き方をよく見てください。つづりの間違いに気づけますか。

en.label: Linking word
en.clue: How are the two ideas around “{l}” related — contrast, cause, sequence? Which linking word signals that?

zh.label: 衔接词
zh.clue: “{l}”前后两层意思是什么关系——转折、因果还是顺序？哪个连接词能表示这种关系？

ja.label: つなぎの言葉
ja.clue: 「{l}」の前後の内容はどんな関係ですか（逆接・因果・順序）。それを示すつなぎの言葉は何でしょう。

en.label: Doesn't make sense
en.clue: Read “{l}” literally: can that actually happen? Which word makes it strange?

zh.label: 语义不通
zh.clue: 按字面读“{l}”：这真的可能吗？是哪个词让它变得奇怪？

ja.label: 意味が通らない
ja.clue: 「{l}」を文字どおりに読んでみましょう。実際にあり得ますか。おかしくしているのはどの語ですか。

en.label: Contradiction
en.clue: Does “{l}” agree with what the rest of the passage says? Where is the clash?

zh.label: 前后矛盾
zh.clue: “{l}”和文章其他地方说的一致吗？矛盾在哪里？

ja.label: 矛盾
ja.clue: 「{l}」は文章の他の部分と合っていますか。どこが食い違っていますか。

en.label: Meaning reversed
en.clue: Compare what “{l}” says with the original meaning: is one positive and the other negative? What flips it?

zh.label: 意思相反
zh.clue: 把“{l}”和原文的意思比一比：是不是一个肯定、一个否定？是什么让意思反过来了？

ja.label: 意味の反転
ja.clue: 「{l}」の意味を原文と比べてみましょう。肯定と否定が逆になっていませんか。何が意味を逆にしていますか。

en.label: Article / determiner
en.clue: Look at the noun in “{l}”: is it countable and singular? Is it new to the reader? What small word does it need?

zh.label: 冠词/限定词
zh.clue: 看“{l}”里的名词：是可数名词单数吗？是第一次提到吗？它前面需要哪个小词？

ja.label: 冠詞・限定詞
ja.clue: 「{l}」の名詞は数えられる単数形ですか。初めて出てくる物ですか。前に何が必要でしょう。

en.label: Preposition
en.clue: Which preposition does the verb or noun in “{l}” normally take for this meaning?

zh.label: 介词
zh.clue: “{l}”里的动词或名词，表达这个意思时通常搭配哪个介词？

ja.label: 前置詞
ja.clue: 「{l}」の動詞や名詞は、この意味のときふつうどの前置詞をとりますか。

en.label: Verb form / tense
en.clue: When does the action in “{l}” happen, compared with the rest of the passage? Which verb form shows that?

zh.label: 动词形式/时态
zh.clue: 和文章其他部分相比，“{l}”里的动作发生在什么时候？哪种动词形式能表示这个时间？

ja.label: 動詞の形・時制
ja.clue: 「{l}」の動作は、文章の他の部分と比べていつのことですか。それを表す動詞の形は何でしょう。

en.label: Verb pattern
en.clue: What form must follow the main verb in “{l}” — to + verb, -ing, or a clause?

zh.label: 动词句型
zh.clue: “{l}”里的主要动词后面应该接什么形式——to do、doing，还是从句？

ja.label: 動詞の文型
ja.clue: 「{l}」の動詞の後ろには、to不定詞・-ing・節のどれが続きますか。

en.label: Agreement
en.clue: Find the subject (or noun) in “{l}”: is it singular or plural? Does the word that goes with it match?

zh.label: 一致关系
zh.clue: 找出“{l}”里的主语（或名词）：是单数还是复数？和它搭配的词一致吗？

ja.label: 一致
ja.clue: 「{l}」の主語（または名詞）は単数ですか、複数ですか。それと組む語の形は合っていますか。

en.label: Pronoun
en.clue: What exactly does the pronoun in “{l}” refer back to? Is that one thing or several?

zh.label: 代词
zh.clue: “{l}”里的代词指的到底是什么？是一个还是多个？

ja.label: 代名詞
ja.clue: 「{l}」の代名詞は何を指していますか。それは一つですか、複数ですか。

en.label: Singular / plural
en.clue: How many things are meant in “{l}” — one or more? Does the noun's form show that?

zh.label: 单复数
zh.clue: “{l}”里指的是一个还是多个？名词的形式体现出来了吗？

ja.label: 単数・複数
ja.clue: 「{l}」が指すものは一つですか、二つ以上ですか。名詞の形はそれを表していますか。

en.label: Phrasal verb
en.clue: The verb in “{l}” is fine — which small word (up, out, on, off…) completes it for this meaning?

zh.label: 短语动词
zh.clue: “{l}”里的动词没错——表达这个意思时，后面该接哪个小词（up、out、on、off等）？

ja.label: 句動詞
ja.clue: 「{l}」の動詞は合っています。この意味には、後ろにどの短い語（up, out など）が必要ですか。

en.label: Word form
en.clue: What part of speech does the slot in “{l}” need — noun, verb, adjective or adverb? Which form of the word is that?

zh.label: 词形/词性
zh.clue: “{l}”里这个位置需要什么词性——名词、动词、形容词还是副词？这个词对应的形式是什么？

ja.label: 語形・品詞
ja.clue: 「{l}」のこの位置にはどの品詞が必要ですか。その語のどの形がそれに当たりますか。

en.label: Measure word
en.clue: What kind of thing is the noun in “{l}”? Which measure word goes with that kind of noun?

en.label: Aspect / negation
en.clue: In “{l}”, is the action completed, experienced, ongoing or habitual? Which marker (or which negator) expresses that?

en.label: 的 / 地 / 得
en.clue: In “{l}”, what follows the de — a noun, a verb, or a description of how the action turned out?

en.label: Complement
en.clue: What is the result or direction of the action in “{l}”? Which word right after the verb shows that?

en.label: 把 / 被 construction
en.clue: In “{l}”, who does what to what? Where must the object go, and what must follow the verb?

en.label: Separable verb
en.clue: The verb in “{l}” is really verb + object. Where can 了, a duration or another person go?

en.label: Coverb
en.clue: Which coverb introduces the person or place in “{l}”, and does that phrase go before or after the verb?

en.label: Connective
en.clue: What relationship links the clauses in “{l}”? What is the matching partner of the connective?

en.label: Topic–comment structure
en.clue: What is “{l}” really about? Try putting that topic first and then saying something about it.

en.label: は / が
en.clue: Is the noun before the particle in “{l}” the topic of the whole sentence, or the subject inside a smaller clause?

en.label: Case particle
en.clue: What role does the noun in “{l}” play for its verb — object, place, destination, tool? Which particle marks it?

en.label: Particle
en.clue: What nuance does the original need at “{l}” — also, only, a limit, a list of examples? Which particle carries it?

en.label: Conjugation
en.clue: Which conjugation group does the verb or adjective in “{l}” belong to? How does that group build this form?

en.label: Tense / aspect
en.clue: Is the action in “{l}” finished, ongoing, habitual or still to come? Which ending expresses that?

en.label: Politeness level
en.clue: What politeness level do the other sentences use? Does the ending of “{l}” match it?

en.label: Counter
en.clue: What kind of object is being counted in “{l}”? Which counter fits it?

en.label: Transitive / intransitive, voice
en.clue: In “{l}”, does someone act on something, or does it happen by itself? Which verb of the pair, or voice, fits?

en.label: Noun modification
en.clue: How should the describing part in “{l}” connect to its noun — plain form, な, or の?

en.label: Clause linking
en.clue: How are the two actions around “{l}” related — sequence, condition, reason? Which linking form shows that?

en.label: Kanji choice
en.clue: The reading in “{l}” is right — which kanji with that reading has the meaning needed here?
